# Smart Home Dashboard - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import devices, sensorreadings, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Smart Home Dashboard API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a smart home dashboard with rooms, devices, device status, monitoring, and...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(devices.router, prefix="/api/devices", tags=["Device Management"])
app.include_router(sensorreadings.router, prefix="/api/sensorreadings", tags=["SensorReading Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Smart Home Dashboard", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Smart Home Dashboard API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`
